title: Genie Agents enhancements and bug fixes
body:
* **Chat sharing (GA)**: Sharing an individual Genie Agent conversation is now generally available. See [Share a conversation](/aws/en/genie-agents/talk-to-genie#share-conversation).
* **Download visualizations on Private Link (Beta)**: You can now download visualization results through the Genie Conversation API on Private Link workspaces in supported regions. See  [Retrieve visualization results (Beta)](/aws/en/genie-agents/conversation-api#get-visualization).
* **File upload fix**: Fixed a bug where the option to upload CSV and Excel files to a Genie Agent from Genie One was removed.
